steps.cap: A player throws a built-in Telegram emoji into the group chat. The value is rolled on Telegram's side, the bot only reads it.
BAR BAR BAR came up. The bot waits for the animation to end, 3-4 seconds, and replies. This is olya's first luck of the day in this chat.
The dart misses the bullseye: silence. The bot doesn't reply to a loss, the branch just ends.
Second luck of the day. The counter in the database went up, and the reply says how many are left until the prize.
The dice has its own rule: a six pays at once, with no counter. The request to the admin follows.
Third luck of the day for olya. The counter reached three, the bot congratulates and names the prize.
"New winner" goes to the admin: nickname, ID, combination, time. The player's counter resets.
A bullseye in darts pays at once. Bowling and basketball work the same way: each emoji has its own values and its own prizes.
One mechanism for five emojis. The game runs on its own, the admin steps in only for the payout.
